OUTLIER RCA — the 57m29s and 50m29s failures (2026-08-14)

Run 31834896849 (57m29s, failure): the first job did not start until 1,513s (25m13s) after workflow creation. The macOS matrix cell began 1,609s after creation and then occupied 1,823s (30m23s). Its default pytest step was 1,697s / 28m17s and failed at the end on test_completion_fail_renders_failure_findings_fallback. Individual >30s phases were old pre-ADR-0096 Pandoc corpus fixture setup 142.11s, editor loopback setup 35.18s, and old real-Pandoc prose fixed-point call 34.06s. Ubuntu cells failed the same test after default steps of 413/442/629s; optional-extras install was 100s; tickets history mount was 44s. Total runner occupancy was 4,097s despite the 3,449s wall because initial org runner starvation dominated.

Run 31841305299 (50m29s, failure): the first job waited 1,453s (24m13s); macOS began 1,535s after creation and ran 1,479s (24m39s). macOS default/integration steps were 1,272s and 121s. The old Pandoc corpus setup was 143.48s and editor setup 35.05s; no Ubuntu individual test exceeded 30s. Mutation ran five long shards (814/705/483/455/337s) and total runner occupancy was 6,914s (115.23 runner-minutes). The run failed a separate lint/complexity gate, but fail-fast:false deliberately allowed the full diagnostic matrix to finish.

Interpretation: the >50m examples are additive, not a single 57m test path: ~24–25m org-wide runner starvation before admission plus ~25–30m macOS execution. The full real-Pandoc corpus phases in these old runs have since moved to External Integration Tests (18f58da624), removing the 142–143s fixture and full replay calls from current Verify. The remaining recurrent >30s individual phase is editor loopback setup, now instrumented by change 1793.

Rejected lever confirmed from tracker history: ad63-17ad-d545-45d4 explicitly preserved fail-fast:false diagnostics when collapsing optionality fan-out. Cancelling sibling cells on the first failure would reduce failed-run occupancy but would reduce failure/coverage diagnostics, contrary to this session constraint and prior decision, so it is not proposed.
